content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the taurage district court the defendant was ordered to pay fees and legal expenses totaling €60812 the court resolved a matrimonial property case by ordering the defendant to acquire a vw passat vehicle the court also recognized the defendants personal debts and obligations the text refers to various articles from the civil code related to matrimonial property the claimant sought to annul their marriage and retain their surname they also wanted to establish the age of their minor son and establish a procedure for the defendants access to the child the claimant requested monthly maintenance payments for the child and to be designated as the administrator of the funds the court ordered the defendant to transfer ownership of the vw passat vehicle to the claimant the defendants personal debts were declared and they were ordered to pay the costs of the proceedings the court resolved the division of the spouses community property and recognized the defendants personal debts the court made its decision based on relevant articles of the civil code and the code of civil procedure the marriage was annulled and both parties kept their respective surnames the defendant was allowed to acquire personal property specifically a vehicle the defendant was recognized as owing personal debts to two parties and was ordered to pay various costs including stamp duty and legal aid fees
